text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction linking the restrictive diagnosis to the prior denial scene

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negative particle fused after the opening conjunction
later exception particle completing the restrictive movement
the written opening that joins conjunction and negation

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps 83:12 attached to 83:11 instead of letting the clause sound like a detached maxim. It opens a continuation in which the following {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) and later {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illa}}) will make the sentence restrictive. Because the conjunction is written and heard with the negator as {{ar:وَمَا}} ({{tr:wa-ma}}), continuation and exclusion arrive together: the ayah does not restart, it explains the moral type behind the denial already in view.

topics.headline: the opening connector keeps the indictment running
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the restriction is a continuation of the previous denial portrait, not a free-standing proverb.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a conjunction, and the clause evidence keeps the whole ayah as one restricted verbal clause following the prior denial scene.

topics.headline: the fused opening launches restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the discourse link and the negation begin as one surface movement toward the later exception.
topics.reason: The bundle separates the conjunction and negative particle as grammatical segments but the written opening joins them, supporting a combined continuation-plus-restriction effect.

words.gloss_range: negative particle whose force is completed by the later exception particle as an exclusive restriction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: exception particle completing the restrictive construction
the excepted subject class admitted after the restriction

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) does more than negate the verb. It opens a field in which denial is first ruled out broadly, then the later {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illa}}) admits only {{ar:كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ}} ({{tr:kullu mu'tadin athimin}}). The subject is delayed until after that exception, so the listener passes through a complete negative field before meeting the culprit-type. The result is qaṣr by negation and exception: the act is not left among many motives or actors, but restricted to one exhaustive moral profile.

topics.headline: negation becomes exclusive diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the negator starts an exclusion pattern, so the clause diagnoses the only kind of person who denies.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies the construction as negation plus exception and warns that its scope must be preserved.

topics.headline: the subject arrives after exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the clause move from universal exclusion to the later named subject, making the subject a diagnosis rather than an ordinary actor.
topics.reason: The subject is licensed after the exception, while the verb and pronominal complement complete the first unit before the subject appears.

topics.headline: the first half of the restriction is audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negator is heard as the opening half of a paired restriction rather than as an isolated denial.
topics.reason: The surface opening joins the negator to the conjunction, and the later exception closes the same local restriction.

words.gloss_range: Form II imperfect active falsifying or declaring false, locally governed by negation and taking an oblique pronominal complement
words.root_gloss_range: falsehood, lying, declaring false, treating as false, and related derivations; the local Form II selects active falsification rather than bare lying or reciprocal dispute

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prepositional pronoun functioning as the object-domain of the verb
delayed restricted subject of the singular verb

words.prose: {{ar:يُكَذِّبُ}} ({{tr:yukadhdhibu}}) is the act placed under the restriction. Its Form II shape makes the root's falsehood field active, and the doubled center lets that force be heard: the denier is not merely mistaken or labeled a liar, but is casting the known matter as false. The verb governs {{ar:بِهِۦٓ}} ({{tr:bihi}}), so the denied object remains a prior referent rather than a new direct object, and its imperfect singular form fits {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}) distributively, as each member's repeatable act. Coming after the same root in 83:10 and 83:11, the word turns a plural denier-portrait into a singular diagnostic predicate, whose only admitted subject is the overstepping, culpable type.

topics.headline: Form II makes denial an active falsifying stance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb names active falsification of truth, not merely an inner doubt or a static liar-label.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a Form II imperfect active verb, and the lexical evidence supports declaring or treating as false as the locally selected branch.

topics.headline: the denied matter is routed through the bāʾ complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the verb is aimed at an already-known object-domain rather than introducing a fresh object inside the ayah.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces {{ar:بِهِۦٓ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) as the prepositional complement, and the valency profile shows this root-form commonly taking a bāʾ complement.

topics.headline: the singular imperfect diagnoses each member
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the universal class is handled one member at a time, with denial presented as a repeatable identifying act.
topics.reason: The verb is 3ms imperfect active, while {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}) is the restricted subject, licensing distributive singular force.

topics.headline: restriction turns the verb into diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees falsification become a diagnostic predicate whose only subject is the transgressive, culpable profile.
topics.reason: The verb is inside the syntactically forced negation-plus-exception construction, and the following descriptors supply the admitted moral class.

topics.headline: nearby denial forms sharpen into a singular act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from the named deniers of 83:10-11 to the single act by which each denier is anatomized in 83:12.
topics.reason: The supplied rows give concrete same-surah references, and the local form changes from plural label or habit to a singular restricted predicate.

topics.headline: the intensified form is heard at the clause front
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the hard, doubled center of the verb match the forceful act of declaring false before the moral tail settles.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows are local and form-specific; they support audible emphasis without changing the lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus third masculine singular pronoun, anaphoric to the prior judgment-day domain and governed as the verb's oblique complement

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: exception pivot following the completed denial unit
the completed denial phrase before the exception

words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦٓ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) keeps the denied matter present without renaming it. The preposition attaches the pronoun to {{ar:يُكَذِّبُ}} ({{tr:yukadhdhibu}}) as an oblique object-domain, while the third masculine suffix points back to the judgment-day domain in 83:11. Because this word completes {{ar:مَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ}} ({{tr:ma yukadhdhibu bihi}}) before {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illa}}), the object recedes and the focus shifts to who can deny it: the known truth is held in place, and the denier's character becomes the issue.

topics.headline: the pronoun keeps the Day already named
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that the denied object is not vague; it is the already named judgment-day domain from 83:11.
topics.reason: The cross-reference evidence strongly licenses the suffix as resuming the prior {{ar:يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ}} ({{tr:yawmi d-dini}}) domain and warns against adding a new explanatory noun.

topics.headline: the bāʾ frame preserves relation rather than a new object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees denial directed toward a known reality through relation and contact, not flattened into a newly named direct object.
topics.reason: The attachment row forces the prepositional phrase as complement of the verb, and the verb frame lists object-domain expression through bāʾ.

topics.headline: the denial unit closes before the exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole denial phrase is already complete before the exception names the denier-class.
topics.reason: The word follows the verb and precedes the exception, so the restrictive construction scopes over a completed verb-plus-complement unit.

topics.headline: the bound form carries the referent into the pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the pronominal object carried forward as one bound form before the clause turns at the exception.
topics.reason: The surface form visibly combines preposition and suffix, and the phonetic row is local to the transition into the exception.

words.gloss_range: exception particle functioning as the hinge that converts prior negation into an exclusive restriction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negative particle whose force the exception completes
universal quantifier immediately introduced by the exception

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illa}}) is the hinge where broad negation becomes exclusive assignment. After the denial phrase has denied the act generally, this compact particle, with its initial hamza and doubled lam, admits only the subject that follows. Its placement directly before {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}) makes the quantifier part of the filter: totality is not loose emphasis, but the exhaustive remainder left by the exception. The clause therefore turns from object-focused denial in 83:11 to subject-focused classification in 83:12.

topics.headline: the exception converts negation into exclusive assignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the particle transform broad denial into a statement about the only admitted denier-class.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as an exception particle, and the translation support explicitly identifies the negation-plus-exception restriction.

topics.headline: the pivot gives totality restrictive force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that every member of the moral type is admitted by the exception, not merely emphasized after it.
topics.reason: The particle stands immediately before {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}), which attachment evidence identifies as the restricted subject.

topics.headline: the clause turns from denied act to classified actor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the ayah's turn from what is denied to who alone can occupy that denial.
topics.reason: The rows give the boundary from 83:11 and the local position of the particle between the completed denial phrase and subject class.

topics.headline: the exception is audibly tight at the turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a compact, doubled pivot at the exact point where the field narrows.
topics.reason: The surface and sound rows are local to the exception particle and support audible emphasis without changing its grammatical role.

words.gloss_range: nominative universal quantifier functioning as the restricted subject and distributing the predicate over every member of the described type
words.root_gloss_range: totality, entirety, eachness, completion, and surrounding imagery; the local use selects distributive every within an exception construction

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: exception particle immediately before the quantifier
predicate borne by the restricted subject
descriptor chain governed under the quantifier

words.prose: {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}) is the first word of the admitted subject after {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illa}}). As a nominative quantifier, it bears the predicate {{ar:يُكَذِّبُ}} ({{tr:yukadhdhibu}}); as a construct-like head, it governs the descriptor chain {{ar:مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ}} ({{tr:mu'tadin athimin}}). That double role makes the subject exhaustive and defined: denial belongs to every member of this transgressive, culpable type, not to a vague crowd or a few examples. The root-family image of totality and enclosure can color the word, while the local grammar keeps the selected force distributive "every." It also answers the open class of 83:11 by closing it into a formula-like moral classification, with parallels such as 45:7 and 26:222, and its doubled sound launches the compact tail that the two tanwīn descriptors complete.

topics.headline: the quantifier bears the restricted predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the exception admits a real subject, and that subject makes every qualifying person carry the falsifying predicate.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}) as subject of the verb after the negation and exception.

topics.headline: totality governs one two-quality profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that overstepping and culpability jointly define the included type under one quantifier.
topics.reason: The quantifier governs {{ar:مُعْتَدٍ}} ({{tr:mu'tadin}}), and {{ar:أَثِيمٍ}} ({{tr:athimin}}) is licensed as its adjective, making one descriptor chain.

topics.headline: every member is counted in
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids treating the class as a loose collective; each qualifying denier is individually included.
topics.reason: The singular quantifier has distributive force in its construct-like phrase and controls the singular predicate member by member.

topics.headline: enclosure imagery colors the exhaustive force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the class enclosed from every side, while still reading the local word as the quantifier "every."
topics.reason: The broader root-family includes surrounding and completion imagery, but local grammar selects the quantifier sense; the image is retained only as pressure on exhaustive scope.

topics.headline: the open denier class closes into a moral formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the previous open relative class answered by a formula-like universal moral classification.
topics.reason: The rows cite concrete formula parallels such as 45:7 and identify the boundary relation from 83:11 to the exhaustive class.

topics.headline: the quantifier launches the closing cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the logical pivot and the two descriptors begin to close as one compact tail.
topics.reason: The sound rows are local to the sequence beginning with the quantifier and do not conflict with the grammatical role.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII active participle describing a boundary-crossing transgressor within the quantified subject class
words.root_gloss_range: crossing beyond, running past, hostility, aggression, and transgression; the local active participle selects an adopted overstepping agent rather than an abstract hostility noun

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: following adjective that supplies culpability to the same type

words.prose: {{ar:مُعْتَدٍ}} ({{tr:mu'tadin}}) supplies the first content of the restricted subject. Governed by {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}), it names the denier as a boundary-crosser before {{ar:أَثِيمٍ}} ({{tr:athimin}}) names the liability attached to that crossing. Its Form VIII active participle makes overstepping an adopted agency: denial is not treated as neutral uncertainty, but as a practiced trespass against the known truth, the kind of exceeded limit prohibited in 2:190. The same close pair appears in 68:12, giving the local tail formulaic weight, while 83:13 shows the overstep in speech when recited signs are dismissed. The sound and tanwīn cadence bind this descriptor to the final guilt word, so outward violation and inward culpability close together.

topics.headline: the first descriptor defines the quantified type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees outward overstepping as the first named content of the only denier-class.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces {{ar:مُعْتَدٍ}} ({{tr:mu'tadin}}) as the genitive complement governed by {{ar:كُلُّ}} ({{tr:kullu}}).

topics.headline: denial is cast as crossing a limit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that falsification is morally pictured as crossing beyond a boundary, not merely occupying an opposing opinion.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports crossing, exceeding, hostility, and aggression, and the local descriptor applies that field to the denier-type.

topics.headline: Form VIII makes transgression adopted agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denier characterized as one practicing overreach, not someone accidentally outside a line.
topics.reason: QAC marks a Form VIII active participle, and the contextual profile supports this as a constrained active-participle group.

topics.headline: overstep and guilt form one moral profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that outward violation and inward liability are paired, not separate optional insults.
topics.reason: The following word is licensed as an adjective of {{ar:مُعْتَدٍ}} ({{tr:mu'tadin}}), and the rows cite the same close pair at 68:12.

topics.headline: the descriptor reinterprets denial as overreach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reads the previous denial as a boundary-crossing stance once this descriptor arrives.
topics.reason: The descriptor follows the falsifying verb in the same restricted clause, and the rows connect the previous denial to this moral diagnosis.

topics.headline: the overstep is sharpened by prohibition and later speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denier as the kind of overstepper that prohibition language defines, and the next ayah then enacts that overstep in speech.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references to 2:190 and the following ayah; they function as contrast and forward bridge without replacing the local parse.

topics.headline: the sound begins the paired closing cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first descriptor begin the same cadence that the final guilt word completes.
topics.reason: The local tanwīn and consonant-texture rows support audible pairing with the final descriptor.

words.gloss_range: qualitative adjective naming settled culpability as the final descriptor of the restricted denier-type
words.root_gloss_range: sin, guilt, culpability, guilt-bearing, accusation of sin, and avoidance of sin in other derivatives; the local fa'il adjective selects settled blameworthy culpability

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: transgressor descriptor qualified by the final adjective

words.prose: {{ar:أَثِيمٍ}} ({{tr:athimin}}) closes the ayah by making the overstep morally accountable. It agrees with {{ar:مُعْتَدٍ}} ({{tr:mu'tadin}}) as the second genitive indefinite descriptor, so guilt is not a separate class or an afterthought; it interprets the same transgressor. The fa'il adjective turns the root's guilt field into a settled personal quality rather than a one-off act or an external accusation, while the broader sense of being withheld from good remains only a secondary coloring of culpability. The pairing has formulaic weight through the same transgression-plus-guilt profile at 68:12, and within the universal restriction that guilt is distributed across every included denier. In final position, and in the same tanwīn cadence as {{ar:مُعْتَدٍ}} ({{tr:mu'tadin}}), the word makes culpability the last sound and the verdict of the restriction, carrying 83:11's denial into the singular actor of 83:13.

topics.headline: guilt qualifies the same transgressor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees culpability attached to the same overstepper, not added as a second independent class.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly licenses {{ar:أَثِيمٍ}} ({{tr:athimin}}) as an adjective of {{ar:مُعْتَدٍ}} ({{tr:mu'tadin}}) with matching indefiniteness and genitive form.

topics.headline: the final word names settled blame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands the denial as accountable guilt-bearing falsification rather than neutral opposition or passing error.
topics.reason: The root and lexical evidence support guilt and culpability, and the local pair with the transgressor descriptor selects settled blame.

topics.headline: the fa'il form makes guilt characterizing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees culpability as a stable quality of the denier-type, not merely the report that someone sinned once.
topics.reason: QAC marks a qualitative adjective, and the row evidence contrasts it with gerund, active-participle, and accusation frames.

topics.headline: other root branches sharpen the selected guilt sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear that this is the opposite of recoiling from sin, with deprivation-from-good only coloring the guilt-bearing profile.
topics.reason: The broader family includes avoidance of sin, accusation, and deprivation senses, but the local adjective selects culpability; those branches survive only as contrast or secondary coloring.

topics.headline: the guilt word completes a recognized pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing profile has formulaic weight through the transgression-plus-guilt pair, including the same pairing at 68:12.
topics.reason: The rows cite 68:12 and recurrent guilt-type formulas, while local grammar keeps the pair under the same restricted subject.

topics.headline: culpability is the ayah's landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels guilt as both semantic closure and sound closure after overstepping has been named.
topics.reason: The word is the final word of the ayah, and the rows tie its position and tanwīn cadence to closure after the transgressor descriptor.

topics.headline: the final type carries into the next response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the guilt descriptor reinterpret the prior denial and prepare the singular actor of the following scene.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect the final descriptor back to 83:11's denial and forward to the singular response in 83:13.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Denial emerges from habitual boundary-crossing.** `ع د و` B001 supplies overstepping a bound into injustice; `ء ث م` B001 supplies slowing or lagging from good; `ك ل ل` B003 supplies totality in `كُلُّ`. The sequence moves from denial to a paired agent-description, and 83:13–14 then shows repeated rejection and accumulated earning. I assign transgression the active crossing role and sin the retarding role that keeps the person from correction. I infer that denial is produced by practice: continued crossing requires delayed moral response. The ayah reads causally, not merely as a label list.

2. **Sin as a load generated by transgression.** `ء ث م` B004 supplies charging or loading sin onto someone. With the marked record of 83:9 and the earning of 83:14, I infer that each overstep loads an attributable item into the account. The reading changes from an inherent “sinner” identity to an accumulating burden whose production can be traced.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The earnings that dominate the heart in 83:14 and the acts returned in 83:36 made `أَثِيم` look less like a static epithet and more like the accumulated loading of repeated oversteps.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Crossing a bound produces forced enclosure.** Lexical evidence: ع د و/B001, "overstepping a bound into injustice," in مُعْتَدٍ. Structural cue: Sijjin supplies confinement at 83:7-8; 83:15 adds blocked access; 83:16 adds enclosing heat. Assigned role: overstepping is the agent's chosen outward movement, while the surrounding forms of enclosure reverse that movement. Abductive move: I infer that later containment answers prior boundary crossing; the packet supplies the spatial opposition but no explicit proportionality formula. Reading change: مُعْتَدٍ becomes the generator of its own closed horizon, not only a generic moral epithet.

2. **Sin as lagging behind a following sign.** Lexical evidence: ء ث م/B001, "slowing and lagging from good," in أَثِيمٍ. Structural cue: 83:13 immediately depicts signs being made to follow in recitation through ت ل و/B001, yet the hearer diverts them into a label; 83:14-15 then shows coating and lost access. Assigned role: B001 describes the sinner as one who repeatedly falls behind the sequence that could lead him forward. Abductive move: I infer that dismissive relabeling is the delaying mechanism; the packet states speech and later coating, not their full cognitive causation. Reading change: أَثِيمٍ reads as arrested responsiveness, a person whose delay compounds until the sign can no longer reach the heart.

3. **The consequence already shadows the epithet.** Lexical evidence: ء ث م/B003, "the punishment of sin," activated in أَثِيمٍ alongside the agentive B001. Structural cue: exclusion and fire follow at 83:15-16, and 83:17 points deictically to what had been denied. Assigned role: B003 folds requital into the lexical field of the sinner before the consequences are narrated. Abductive move: I infer that the branch licenses prospective pressure, not that the adjective grammatically means punishment. Reading change: the final epithet is not a static label; it carries the approaching return of the act within it.

4. **Totality as a whole character mechanism.** Lexical evidence: ك ل ل/B003, "totality and completeness," in كُلُّ. Structural cue: the ayah combines denial, boundary crossing, and lagging sin, then 83:13-17 traces speech, accumulation, screening, and consequence. Assigned role: totality binds these not as unrelated offenses but as a complete behavioral loop. Abductive move: I infer that كُلُّ has qualitative as well as distributive force here; its explicit grammatical work is universalization. Reading change: the verse profiles a whole denial-producing character system rather than claiming that one isolated mistake mechanically entails disbelief.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The ثُمَّ sequence ending in the deictic هَٰذَا at 83:16-17 made ء ث م/B003 more than a lexical shadow: the punishment branch becomes narratively present inside five ayat. The same sequence confirmed that lagging behind recited signs can harden into the no-exit result of overstepping.

baseline.text: Onu ancak sınırı aşan her günahkâr yalanlar.

findings.text: Sınırı aşma yönündeki seçilmiş hareket, Siccîn, perde ve ateşle çevrili kapalı bir ufku kendi karşılığı olarak üretir.
Günahkârlık, ardı ardına gelen işaretlerin gerisinde kalıp düzeltici çağrıya verilen cevabı sürekli geciktiren bir duruma dönüşür.
Günahkâr sıfatı, daha sonuçlar anlatılmadan eylemin yaklaşan cezasını kendi anlam alanında taşır.
Her sınır aşımı, kişiye özden gelen değişmez bir kimlik vermekten çok kayda eklenen izlenebilir bir yük üretir.
Bütünlük bildiren söz, yalanlama, sınır aşma ve gecikmeyi ayrı kusurlar değil, birbirini besleyen eksiksiz bir davranış çevrimi olarak toplar.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Moral Boundary, Repair, and Returned Judgment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Conduct is measured by whether it preserves or crosses a moral limit, then returns to the actor as blame, repair, or recompense.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same cycle extends backward to delay before good and forward to confession, renunciation, and expiation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Sin, Crime, and Transgression
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An actor crosses a limit, turns breach into an offense, and bears the identity and consequence of wrongdoing.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: punishable sin `ء ث م:B003/m01`; crime or culpable offense `ج ر م:B004/m01`; crossing the just limit `ع د و:B001/m01`; violation of right and restraint `ف ج ر:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The motifs form a single moral sequence: breach of a boundary becomes a defined offense, the offense identifies its agent, and culpability makes punishment intelligible.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Abstention begins the repair, renunciation separates the actor from the wrong, and expiation addresses what remains. The scene closes by re-entry into active good rather than mere nonparticipation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: Moral Boundary, Repair, and Returned Judgment

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Imputation, Suspicion, and Confession

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Imputation supplies the charge, suspicion supplies its uncertain social circulation, and confession reverses that uncertainty by making responsibility explicit.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi anlamı doğruluğun karşıtı olarak kurar ve bu karşıtlığın hem sözde hem davranışta gerçekleşebildiğini açıkça belirtir. Kişiyi bu nitelikle betimleyen biçimler aynı çekirdeğe bağlıdır; birini yalancı sayma eylemi ise ayrı dalın konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gerçeğe aykırı söz ve davranışı kapsar; başkasını yalancılıkla niteleme eylemini ya da özel kalıpların bağımsız anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın anlam çekirdeğini verir; kişi betimleyen türevler ile özürlere ilişkin kalıp yalnız kendi sözcüksel karşılıklarında gösterilir ve yalın anlama eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir sözün veya davranışın doğruluğa aykırı olmasıdır. Bu niteliği taşıyan kişi, yalan söyleyen ya da yalanı çokça tekrarlayan biri olarak betimlenebilir.

facets.statement: Doğruluğa aykırılık hem söylenen bir sözde hem de yapılan bir davranışta gerçekleşebilir.
Bu niteliği taşıyan veya onu sıkça gösteren kişi, yalan söyleyen kişi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, doğruluğa aykırılığı ortak çekirdek sayar; kullanım alanını söz ve davranış olarak verir ve bu niteliği taşıyan kişiye yönelik adlandırmaları aynı anlam çevresinde toplar.

concept_gloss.text: sözde veya davranışta doğruluğa aykırılık
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hem söz hem davranış alanındaki bütün yalın anlam çekirdeğini karşılayan açıklayıcı üst karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Doğruluğa karşıtlığı ve bunun söz ile davranıştaki kapsamını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlamın söz veya davranıştaki doğruluğa aykırılığı zaten belirginleştirdiği doğal kullanımlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Doğruluğa aykırılık çekirdeğini ve kişiye yüklenebilen niteliği doğal Türkçeyle korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir sözü yalan sayma, birini yalancı bulma veya ona yalancılık yükleme işlemini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da doğruluk ile gerçeğe aykırılık arasındaki değerlendirme alanındadır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir işlemi değil, birbirine bağlı iki işlemi içerir: bir kişiyi veya sözü yalanla nitelemek ve bazı türemiş biçimlerde kişiyi yalancı bulmak ya da yalanını açığa çıkarmak. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu ayrım tek bir genel 'yalan yükleme' anlatımı içinde eritilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalan üretmeyi değil, kişi veya söz hakkında yalan hükmü vermeyi ve belirli türevlerde bu hükmü bulguya dayandırmayı kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, türemiş ve nesne alan biçimlerinin farklı işlemlerini ayırır; bunlardan hiçbiri yalın biçimin genel yalan anlamı olarak sunulmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi veya sözü yalanla ilişkilendirerek yalan olduğunu söylemektir. Bazı türemiş biçimlerde işlem, kişiyi yalancı bulma ya da yalanını ortaya çıkarma sonucunu bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi veya söz, yalan olduğu söylenerek doğruluk bakımından olumsuz değerlendirilir.
Belirli türemiş biçimler, kişiyi yalancı bulmayı veya onun yalanını ortaya çıkarmayı bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, birini ya da bir sözü yalanla niteleme konusunda birleşir; aynı toplu kanıt, ayrı bir türemiş biçimde kişiyi yalancı bulma veya yalanı açığa çıkarma yorumunu da taşır.

concept_gloss.text: yalan sayma veya yalancı bulma

error_profile.preserves: Yalan hükmü vermeyi ve türemiş biçimde yalancı bulma işlemini ayrı ayrı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir sözün veya kişinin söylediğinin yalan olduğunu bildiren bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.loses: Kişiyi yalancı bulma ve yalanını ortaya çıkarma sonucunu tek başına göstermez.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğruluk hakkında verilen hükümdür; komşu dal ise gerçekleşmemiş belirli bir eylemin kişiye isnat edilmesidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli bir kalıbı zorunluluk bildirme ve bir işi yapmaya yöneltme anlamlarıyla açıklar. Bu anlamın yalan söylemeyle doğrudan bir bileşeni yoktur ve yalnız söz konusu kalıp içinde geçerlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, belirli kalıbın 'sana düşer, onu yap' anlamıyla sınırlıdır; yalın köke genel bir zorunluluk veya özendirme anlamı vermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca verilen kalıplaşmış söyleyişi açıklar; zorunluluk ve yöneltme anlamları yalın biçime taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir kalıp içinde, bir şeyin kişiye düşen bir yükümlülük olduğunu bildirmek veya kişiyi onu yapmaya yöneltmektir.

facets.statement: Kalıp, söz konusu işin muhataba düşen bir yükümlülük olduğunu bildirir.
Aynı kalıp, muhatabı o işi üstlenmeye yönelten güçlü bir özendirme olarak kullanılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu kalıplaşmış söyleyişi, bir işin muhataba düşmesi ve muhatabın o işi yapmaya yöneltilmesi anlamlarında ortaklaşa açıklar.

concept_gloss.text: onu üstlen; sana düşer

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi savaş hamlesindeki iki karşıt kalıbı birlikte verir: olumlu biçim hamlede durma, geri çekilme veya korkaklık; olumsuz biçim ise durmadan ilerleyip vuruşa ulaşmadır. Dalın kimliği bu kutuplu kalıp düzenine uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız saldırı hamlesi bağlamında ve olumlu-olumsuz biçimlerin karşıtlığıyla geçerlidir; genel yalan veya genel cesaret anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım savaş hamlesine bağlı iki kalıbı korur; duraksama ve kararlılıkla ilerleme anlamları yalın biçime genellenmez.

facets.statement: Olumlu kalıp, saldırıya geçtikten sonra durmayı, geri kalmayı veya korkaklık göstermeyi bildirir.
Olumsuz kalıp, saldırganın durmadan ilerleyerek vuruşa kadar hamleyi sürdürdüğünü bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar saldırı hamlesini sürdürmeme ile korkaklık arasında bağ kurar; olumsuz kalıp ise durmayıp vuruşa kadar ilerleme anlamını verir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız verilen olumsuz kalıbın gecikmeme anlamını açıklar; hız ve çabukluk yalın kökün anlamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir olumsuz kalıp içinde, bir kişinin söz konusu işi yapmakta oyalanmadığını ve gecikmeden yaptığını bildirir.

facets.statement: Kişi, belirtilen işi yapmadan önce beklemez veya oyalanmaz.
Beklememenin sonucu, işin gecikmeden gerçekleştirilmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak açıklaması, belirli kalıbın kişinin bir işi yapmakta beklemediğini ve gecikmediğini bildirmesidir.

concept_gloss.text: gecikmeden yapmak
concept_gloss.applicability: Kalıbın hem oyalanmama aşamasını hem de işi gecikmeden gerçekleştirme sonucunu özlü biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Beklememeyi ve söz konusu işi gecikmeden yapmayı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz konusu işin beklenmeden gerçekleştiği geçmiş zaman anlatımlarında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Oyalanmama aşamasını ve işin gecikmeden gerçekleşmesini doğal kullanımda korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gecikmemeyi yalnız belirli bir 'yapmakta oyalanmadı' kalıbında bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ayrı bir kullanımda koşmanın görece hızlı oluşunu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir işi yapmakta az bekleme veya hiç oyalanmama anlamında iki dal büyük ölçüde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnız kalıplaşmış gecikmeme anlamıdır; komşu dal benzer kalıbın yanında koşma hızına ilişkin ayrı bir alan da taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir işi yapmak öncesindeki gecikmenin bulunmadığını kalıplaşmış biçimde bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Eylemin ilk anda, durum henüz yatışmadan veya olayın başlangıç itkisiyle yapılmasını vurgular.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: gecikmeden yapma ile ilk anda yapma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir eylemin beklenmeden ve hemen gerçekleşmesi iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bekleme süresinin yokluğuna odaklanır; komşu dal eylemin durumun ilk anındaki oluşunu ayrıca şart koşar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli bir işin yapılmasında gecikme olmadığını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi vaktinden önce isteme, öne alma ve genel acele ettirme alanlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İşin kısa sürede veya beklenmeden yapılması bağlamında iki anlam kesişebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnız gecikmenin yokluğunu bildirir; komşu dal hızlandırma, öne alma ve vaktinden önce isteme gibi ek yönler taşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; gecikmeme, ilk anda yapma ve genel acele arasındaki sınırı en iyi gösteren üç aday seçildi, yalnız zaman veya tekrar alanını paylaşan adaylar dışarıda bırakıldı.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قولهم ما كذب فلان أن فعل كذا إذا لم يلبث ولم يتأخر
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الكذب في الخبر، ولا وجوب كذب عليك، ولا كذب اللبن
branches.source_phrase_ar: ما كذب فلان أن فعل كذا أي ما لبث (maqayis;sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dişi devenin sütünün gitmesini ortak çekirdek olarak verir; toplu kanıttaki ek açıklama, bir süre devam edeceği sanılan sütün beklenenden önce kesilmesini belirtir. Geçici çerçeve iki yönü de doğru sınırlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız dişi devenin sütüne ilişkin kalıpta, sütün kaybolması veya beklenen süre boyunca devam etmemesiyle sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız dişi devenin sütünü konu alan kalıba bağlıdır; genel tükenme veya genel beklenti boşa çıkması anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Dişi devenin sütünün kaybolması veya bir süre devam edeceği sanıldığı halde beklenenden önce kesilmesidir.

facets.statement: Dişi devenin sütü gider veya kesilir.
Bir açıklamada süt bir süre sürecek sanılır, fakat bu beklentinin tersine devam etmez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt sütün gitmesi çekirdeğinde birleşir; bunun yanında, devam edeceği sanılan sütün beklenen süreyi tamamlamadan kesilmesi biçiminde daha ayrıntılı bir yorum da verir.

concept_gloss.text: sütün kesilmesi veya beklenenden önce tükenmesi
concept_gloss.applicability: Dişi devenin sütüne bağlı kaybolma çekirdeğini ve devam beklentisinin boşa çıkmasını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Sütün gitmesini, süreklilik beklentisini ve bu beklentinin gerçekleşmemesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sütün artık gelmediği ve önceki üretimin sona erdiği bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Dişi devenin sütünün gitmesi veya sona ermesi çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Sütün süreceği beklentisinin özellikle boşa çıkmış olduğunu tek başına bildirmez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sütün belirli bir süre devam edeceği beklentisinin gerçekleşmediği açıklayıcı bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sütün devamına ilişkin beklentiyi ve beklenenden önce kesilmesini birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: dişi devenin sütü kesildi veya umulduğu kadar sürmedi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dişi devenin sütünün gitmesini ve beklenen süre boyunca devam etmemesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sütün azalmasını veya kesilmesini yağmurun azalması ve kesilmesiyle aynı anlam alanında kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: sütün beklenmedik kesilmesi ile verimin azalması
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Sütün azalması veya bütünüyle kesilmesi iki dalın doğrudan ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal dişi devenin sütüne ve kimi kullanımda boşa çıkan süreklilik beklentisine bağlıdır; komşu dal süt veriminin azalmasını ve yağmuru da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sütün fiilen gittiğini veya beklenen süre boyunca devam etmediğini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sütü kesilen ya da sütü kuşkulu olan hayvanda sütün geri dönmesi umudunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: sütün kesilmesi ile geri dönme umudu
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kesilmiş veya belirsiz hale gelmiş süt verimi durumunu konu alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gerçekleşen kaybı ve boşa çıkan devam beklentisini anlatır; komşu dal kayıptan sonraki geri dönüş umuduna odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sütün kaybolmasını, kesilmesini veya beklenenden az sürmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dişi devenin süt bakımından çok verimli ve bol oluşunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da dişi devenin süt veriminin durumu üzerinde ortak bir nicelik ekseni kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal süt veriminin sona eren kutbundadır; komşu dal aynı alanın bol ve güçlü verim kutbundadır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; süt kesilmesi, geri dönüş beklentisi ve süt bolluğu eksenini açıklayan üç aday seçildi, yalnız başka sıvıları veya hayvan özelliklerini paylaşan adaylar dışarıda bırakıldı.
